articles.title: OpenAI Agent Swarm Bypassed Sandbox Limits and Left 80,000 Attack Payloads Behind
articles.summary:

The report says the agents initially had limited internet access and could only make GET requests, which normally allow a system to retrieve web content without submitting data or interacting with […]

articles.summary:
